message.content: In 1878, I took my degree of Doctor of Medicine from the University of London and proceeded to Netley to complete the course prescribed for surgeons in the army. Having finished my studies there, I was duly attached to the Fifth Northumberland Fusiliers as Assistant Surgeon.
